title: Page 7
content_zh:
等她渐渐长大，明白了父母之间的争执后，也曾怨过恨过，也曾发誓就当自己没有这个父亲。可是当她嫁了人，尤其这三年跟随着婆婆郑氏见识了更多的人情世故，见识了各个权贵之家里面的妻妾之争、嫡庶之争、家产之争等等，明白了很多家务事真的分不出绝对的是非对错，也明白了血缘至亲不可轻抛。

她的母亲已经不在了，而她的父亲还好好地活着，她总不能等到父亲也死了，她真正变成了孤女，再去哀叹「子欲养而亲不待」。

所以，正如原平之所说，顾惜恩婚后就一直没有断了对顾景宏经济上的支持，顾家虽然还号称伯爵府，但是因为不被皇帝玄昱乐见，早已境况凄凉，日子相当艰难了。

等顾惜恩换好了衣裳，原平之道：「走吧，我陪你一起去见岳父。」

顾惜恩微微一笑，她最喜欢夫君的就是他的这份体贴，当年她那么小嫁入原府，如果不是原平之，她恐怕早就吓哭了。

客厅里，顾景宏正坐立难安。

这三年来，他越发老了，头发花白了大半，脸上的皱纹也更深刻，身形也更见瘦削，驼背得更厉害了。

升平大长公主的去世对他的打击相当大。

这世上有一种人，总喜欢把自己不愿意面对的事情往后拖延，今天拖明天，明天拖后天，一日拖一日地往后拖延，顾景宏就是这样——他对大长公主还是相当有感情的，他在两个庶子出生后就有些后悔了，打算向公主道歉，发誓以后不再纳妾，不再生子，只要顾家有血脉延续就足够了。他想挽回和公主的感情，可是他又觉得男人的面子重要，觉得对一个女人低头很羞耻，道歉的事就一日拖一日。他总觉得时间还来得及，可是随着他一日一日拖延，两人的感情越来越恶劣，大长公主也突然撒手归西，让他再也没有了低头道歉的机会。

明日复明日，明日何其多？我生待明日，万事成蹉跎。

顾景宏的一生，就是这样的悲剧。

第9章(2)

听到脚步声，顾景宏从座位上站起了身，这些年被外人冷漠待遇，让他再也难以端什么伯爷驸马的架子，对谁都先陪出三分笑脸。

「父亲。」顾惜恩率先施礼。

「岳父登门，小婿有失远迎，还请见谅。」原平之也弯腰行礼。

「没什么，没什么。」顾景宏连连摆手，说：「倒是我冒昧登门，事先也没打声招呼，才真正失礼了。」

「自家人哪里需要这么客气，岳父快请坐。」原平之笑呵呵地请顾景宏上座，顾景宏连连摆手不肯，翁婿俩最终分宾客之位坐下。

小丫鬟重新为三人奉上了热茶，然后恭敬地退到门外守候。

「父亲，您可是有什么事情？」顾惜恩见父亲坐立难安的模样，自己也替他难受，一个大男人越到老年越落魄，谁见了也会不忍，何况还是她的生父。

因为这些年的隔绝，顾惜恩不会对顾景宏有多尊敬和亲近，但是也不会恶毒地唾弃他，说他一句罪有应得。

其实按照传统道德来评判，顾景宏到底有什么罪呢？不孝有三，无后为大，他想要个儿子真的不算有罪。

在世人的眼里，他甚至很无辜受害，是皇权压迫下的可怜虫。如果他娶了个普通的千金贵女，那他的妻子肯定不敢像升平大长公主这么「欺负」他。

顾景宏唯一的过错，大概就是没有认清自己的身分，他娶了公主，却没有给予公主应有的尊重，所以公主愤怒了，皇家生气了，他这个驸马就被打入「冷宫」了。

至于公主更看重的感情的背叛什么的，世人谁理会这些呢？

娶老婆生孩子，延续家族血脉，是时下世人的共识，至于其他的，可有可无，感情什么的，能当饭吃吗？

但顾景宏和那种抛弃糟糠之妻、另娶年轻漂亮新人的忘恩负义之辈还是有些不同的，他只是有些软弱，甚至懦弱，在延续香火与夫妻之情之间左右摇摆，他想求个两全，结果公主不给他两全的机会，所以才发生如此悲剧。

「呃……」顾景宏用手端着茶杯，脸色微赧，鼓了鼓勇气，才低声道：「我听说四公子就要北上蓟城，所以想替你兄弟找点事儿做，如果方便的话，随便给他们安排个什么职事，如果能让他们得到点锻炼就更好了，他们也大了，整日在家里赋闲，总不是办法。」

原平之微微颔首。

自从外界知道了他主持建造新京城之后，这些天来找他说项的达官贵族和亲戚朋友络绎不绝，大多都是想为自家的子弟找个清闲又有油水的事做。

谁都懂得，最容易贪污的就是工程，而油水最大的工程就是皇家工程，现在原平之把持着皇家最大的、或者说全国最大的一件工程，他手指缝里随便漏一漏，那将会有多少利益可沾？

顾惜恩却皱了皱眉，问：「是惜贤还是惜良？他们现在还是应该读书的年纪吧？建设新京城事关重大，不是能够随便混日子的地方，他们可不能存了偷懒揩油水的心思。」

顾景宏连忙道：「不会！不会！我在家里已经再三教育过，这是非常重要的事，一旦出了差错是要掉脑袋的，可不敢混日子。惜贤和惜良书读得不好，武艺也普通，我想早点让他们出来跟着锻炼锻炼，趁着年少，能多学点东西，他们都想去……」

顾惜贤、顾惜良和顾惜恩年纪一般大，只是三人出生的月份各自不同，当年这也是大长公主很生气的原因。

顾惜恩看了看原平之，见他对自己悄悄竖起一根手指，心底微微松了口气。

夫君肯提携就好，哪怕只是一个。

说起来，建设新京城实在是庞大的工程，需要的人员非常多，要安插一些纨裤子弟并非难事，但是原平之不肯轻易开这个口，这件事太重要，大意不得。

顾惜恩于是对父亲说：「北方初平定，还不是太安稳，两个弟弟总要有一个留在家中孝敬长辈。惜贤和惜良，我都是以前只见过几面，惜贤似乎性子很倔，惜良更平和一些。我看不如让惜贤留在家里支撑门户，让惜良出外锻炼吧？」

顾景宏也知道自己的庶长子个性冲动，容易惹事，而且他也不愿将两个儿子都送出去，如果有个万一可怎么好？

所以他立即同意了女儿的建议，说：「好！好！就让惜良去好了，惜良更老实更能吃苦些，让他去好。」

这么说着，顾景宏却将目光试探地看向原平之，没有原平之的允肯，他是无论如何也不能放心。

原平之笑道：「今日下午就让惜良来家里一趟吧，我看看他擅长些什么，或者先跟着我一阵子，慢慢学些东西再独立工作也行。」

「好！好！我这就回家去，让他准备准备！」顾景宏顿时大喜过望，立即放下茶杯站了起来，迫不及待就要回家去。

原平之和顾惜恩亲自将顾景宏送到二门口，见他上了马车，逐渐远去了，夫妻两人才回转藤萝馆。

途中，顾惜恩轻轻挽住原平之的手，轻声道：「夫君，我们一定会感情如一白首偕老的，对不对？」

父母感情不睦，母亲早逝，父亲落魄，看着这样的结局，顾惜恩真的难过。

原平之没有回答她，只是反握住她的手，轻轻拍了拍。

承诺什么的，只有经历了时间的验证，才会真正珍贵，他希望到了晚年，她已经不需要这样不安地向他询问。
content_en:
When she grew up and understood the disputes between her parents, she also complained and vowed to pretend that she did not have such a father.But when she got married, especially in the past three years with her mother-in-law Zheng, she had seen more of the world, and witnessed the disputes between wives and concubines, disputes between concubines and concubines, disputes over family property, etc. in various powerful families. She understood that there is really no absolute right from wrong in many household matters, and she also understood that blood relatives should not be thrown away lightly.

Her mother is gone, but her father is still alive and well. She can't wait until her father dies too, and she truly becomes an orphan, and then laments that "the son wants to be raised but cannot be cared for".

Therefore, as Yuan Pingzhi said, Gu Xien has continued to support Gu Jinghong financially after their marriage. Although the Gu family is still known as the Earl's Palace, it has been in a miserable situation because it is not favored by Emperor Xuan Yu, and life is quite difficult.

After Gu Xien had changed her clothes, Yuan Pingzhi said: "Let's go, I will accompany you to meet your father-in-law."

Gu Xien smiled slightly. What she liked most about her husband was his thoughtfulness. When she married into Yuan Mansion at such a young age, if it hadn't been for Yuan Pingzhi, she would have been scared to tears.

In the living room, Gu Jinghong was sitting uneasily.

Over the past three years, he has become older, with most of his hair turning gray, the wrinkles on his face becoming deeper, his body becoming thinner, and his hunchback getting worse.

The death of Princess Shengping was a huge blow to him.

There is a kind of person in this world who always likes to put off things that he doesn't want to face. Today he puts off tomorrow, tomorrow he puts off the day after tomorrow, day after day. Gu Jinghong is like this - he still has feelings for the eldest princess. He regretted it after the birth of his two bastards. He planned to apologize to the princess and vow not to take concubines or have children again. As long as the Gu family can continue the bloodline, it is enough.He wanted to restore his relationship with the princess, but he also felt that a man's face was important and felt that it was shameful to bow to a woman, so the apology was delayed day by day.He always felt that there was still enough time, but as he delayed day by day, the relationship between the two became worse and worse, and the eldest princess suddenly gave up and passed away, leaving him no more chance to bow his head and apologize.

Tomorrow after tomorrow, how many tomorrows are there?If I wait for tomorrow, everything will be wasted.

Gu Jinghong's life was such a tragedy.

Chapter 9(2)

Hearing the footsteps, Gu Jinghong stood up from his seat. Over the years, he had been treated indifferently by outsiders, which made it difficult for him to act like an uncle and his consort, and always smile at everyone.

"Father." Gu Xi'en took the lead in saluting.

"My father-in-law is here, but my son-in-law is a little far away to greet me. Please forgive me." Yuan Pingzhi also bowed and saluted.

"Nothing, nothing." Gu Jinghong waved his hands repeatedly and said, "It's really rude that I came to the door without saying hello beforehand."

"Why do I need to be so polite? Father-in-law, please take a seat." Yuan Pingzhi smiled and asked Gu Jinghong to take a seat. Gu Jinghong repeatedly waved his hands and refused, and the father-in-law and his son-in-law finally sat down as guests.

The little maid served hot tea to the three of them again, and then respectfully retreated to wait outside the door.

"Father, what's the matter with you?" Gu Xi'en saw her father fidgeting, and she felt sorry for him. A grown man becomes more and more depressed as he gets older, and no one would be able to bear it, let alone her biological father.

Because of these years of isolation, Gu Xien would not respect and be close to Gu Jinghong, but she would not viciously spurn him and say that he deserved it.

In fact, according to traditional morality, what crime did Gu Jinghong commit?There are three kinds of unfilial piety, the worst of which is not having an offspring. It is really not a crime for him to have a son.

In the eyes of the world, he was even an innocent victim, a pitiful creature under the oppression of imperial power.If he married an ordinary rich girl, then his wife would definitely not dare to "bully" him like Princess Shengping.

Gu Jinghong's only fault was probably that he didn't recognize his identity. He married the princess, but didn't give her the respect she deserved. So the princess became angry, the royal family became angry, and he, the consort, was relegated to the "cold palace."

As for the emotional betrayal that the princess values ​​more, who in the world cares about this?

Marrying a wife, having children, and continuing the family lineage is the consensus of the world nowadays. As for other things, they are dispensable. Can feelings and other things be used as food?

But Gu Jinghong is still a little different from the ungrateful people who abandon their useless wives and marry young and beautiful newcomers. He is just a little weak, even cowardly, wavering between continuing the incense and the love of husband and wife. He wants to have both, but the princess does not give him the opportunity to have both, so this tragedy happened.

"Uh..." Gu Jinghong held the tea cup with his hand, his face was slightly shy, and he plucked up his courage before whispering: "I heard that the fourth young master is going north to Jicheng, so I want to find something to do for your brothers. If it is convenient, I can arrange any job for them. It would be better if it can give them some exercise. They are also old, and it is not an option to stay at home all day long."

Yuan Pingzhi nodded slightly.

Ever since the outside world knew that he was presiding over the construction of the new capital, there has been an endless stream of high-ranking officials, nobles, relatives and friends who have come to him these days to express their opinions. Most of them want to find a leisurely and profitable job for their children.

Everyone knows that projects are the easiest to be corrupted, and the most profitable projects are royal projects. Now Yuan Pingzhi controls the largest project in the royal family, or the largest project in the country. If something leaks between his fingers, how much profit will there be?

Gu Xien frowned and asked, "Are they praising talents or cherishing talents? They are still at the age where they should be studying, right? The construction of the new capital city is of great importance, and it is not a place where you can just hang around. They can't be lazy and take advantage of it."

Gu Jinghong said quickly: "No! No! I have taught you repeatedly at home that this is a very important thing. If something goes wrong, you will lose your head, so don't dare to mess around. Xixian and Xiliang are not good at reading, and their martial arts skills are also average. I want to let them come out to practice as soon as possible. While they are young, they can learn more. They all want to go..."

Gu Xixian, Gu Xiliang and Gu Xien are of the same age, but they were born in different months. This was the reason why the eldest princess was very angry back then.

Gu Xien looked at Yuan Pingzhi and saw him quietly raising a finger to her, feeling slightly relieved in her heart.

It’s good if your husband is willing to support you, even if it’s just one person.

Speaking of which, the construction of the new capital city is indeed a huge project that requires a lot of people. It is not difficult to install some dudes. However, Yuan Pingzhi is unwilling to talk about it easily. This matter is too important to be careless.

Gu Xien then said to her father: "The north has just been pacified and it is not very stable yet. One of the two younger brothers must stay at home and honor the elders. I have only met Xixian and Xiliang a few times before. Xixian seems to be very stubborn, while Xiliang is more peaceful. I think it is better to let Xixian stay at home to support the family and let Xiliang go out to exercise?"

Gu Jinghong also knew that his eldest son was impulsive and prone to trouble, and he was unwilling to send both sons away. What if there was an emergency?

So he immediately agreed to his daughter's suggestion and said, "Okay! Okay! Let Xiliang go. Xiliang is more honest and can endure hardships, so let him go."

Saying this, Gu Jinghong looked at Yuan Pingzhi tentatively. Without Yuan Pingzhi's consent, he could not rest assured in any case.

Yuan Pingzhi said with a smile: "Let Xi Liang come to my house this afternoon and let me see what he is good at. Or you can follow me for a while and slowly learn something before working independently."

"Okay! Okay! I'll go home right now and let him get ready!" Gu Jinghong was overjoyed and immediately put down his tea cup and stood up, eager to go home.

Yuan Pingzhi and Gu Xien personally sent Gu Jinghong to the second gate. Seeing him getting on the carriage and gradually leaving, the couple returned to the Tengluo Pavilion.

On the way, Gu Xi'en gently held Yuan Pingzhi's hand and said softly: "Husband, we will definitely grow old together, right?"

His parents were not on good terms, his mother died young, and his father fell into despair. Seeing this ending, Gu Xien was really sad.

Yuan Pingzhi didn't answer her, he just held her hand and patted it gently.

Promises will only be truly valuable if they are tested by time. He hoped that in her later years, she would no longer need to ask him uneasily.
